about.html:
Company Profile

Leading Global Health & Wellness Innovation for Physical and Financial Well-being

Phyto Science Sdn Bhd, is a global health & wellness company stands at the forefront of product innovation and committed to helping people take control of their health, both physical and financial well-being. Founded in 2012 on little more than dreams and hard work, Phyto Science is now a multi-million dollar company, based in Kuala Lumpur. It was started based on the integrated and advanced e-commerce platform and vision to penetrate into global markets. In just a short span of 18 months after its inception, Phyto Science’s monthly sales have surged to USD 15 Millions, making it one of the TOP MLM companies in Malaysia.

At Phyto Science, we are the TrendMaker. We’re in the Business of Life Transformation!

Transformation is a bold promise to make but we do so with full confidence. We believe that natural health and wellness have the power to transform lives and through our cutting edge products, our people, and our business opportunities, we work to make it a reality everyday.

Phyto Science delivers the amazing transformation through its powerful quadripartite P-system.

Products. Cutting edge, award-winning, scientifically proven & clinically researched, supported by Mibelle Biochemistry Switzerland. (Learn more about Mibelle Biochemistry and PhytoCellTec™) Our unique & exclusive formulas are innovative, and the results are real.

Plan. PhytoScience rewards all its distributors with one of the most lucrative and balanced financial reward plans in the industry. Our lucrative financial reward plans are built-in with plentiful incentives all-year-round to enable our valued distributors to enjoy the journey to their dream life.
›› Learn more about our Business Opportunity

Platform. PhytoScience doesn’t settle for conventional network marketing strategies. We adopt and integrate the latest information technology with a cutting-edge on-line platform that distributors love.

People. Network marketing is all about people – “People’s Business”. It’s about fulfilling people’s needs, dreams and aspirations. PhytoScience emphasizes strongly in building the well-being of its distributors, customers, partners and staff. PhytoScience holds the belief and philosophy of “Your success is our Success” and shares an emotional reward no other networking company can match. Products Platform People Plans The culture of PhytoScience spirals from the core values and solidarity of our Founders in connecting people on a heart-to-heart level. As a result, our worldwide family of distributors, customers, partners and staff experience rewarding relationships based on mutual respect, care, trust, and love.

 

Our Vision

  • Become the world’s premier Health & Wellness company enriching the lives of people who yearns to be wholesome
  • To be the top notch renown MLM company in the world.
 

Our Mission

To empower the lives and well-being of our members, partners, customers, and staff with the highest quality, scientifically proven & clinically researched products, innovative and best business opportunities.
 

Our Promise

  • Always committed to uncompromising product quality
  • Continue to innovate and provide utmost rewarding opportunity
  • Constantly provide excellent value-for-money products and services
  • Committed to create a caring, inspiring & a gratifying environment for our members, customers, partners and staff

Founder

THE LATE TAN SRI LAI TECK PENG
(P.S.M.,S.S.A.P)
Founder

Tan Sri Lai Teck Peng founded Phyto Science with a passion of helping others and a love for business. Tan Sri Lai sets the vision and strategies for the company.

Tan Sri Lai brings with him more than 28 years of significant network marketing experience and track record as a successful network marketing entrepreneur as well as extensive leadership and operational management skills in global consumer-oriented businesses. He is also known for his capabilities and success in creating effective corporate systems, implementing key business strategies for Multi-Level Marketing companies, excellent aptitude in product development, procurement, management information system, finance, as well as sales and marketing.

On 26th November, 2013, he was bestowed the honorary title of Darjah Sri Sultan Ahmad Shah Pahang (SSAP) which carries the title ‘Dato’ Sri’ by his Royal Highness The Sultan of Pahang. On 6th June 2015, again he was bestowed the honorary title of PSM which carries the tittle ‘Tan Sri’ by his Royal Highness Sri Paduka Baginda Agong.

PUAN SRI DATIN SRI ELA TAN
Co-founder cum Managing Director

Puan Sri Datin Sri Ela Tan is an icon in the MLM industry with more than two decades of experience in various leadership capacities. She co-founded Phyto Science Sdn Bhd in 2012 and the company’s phenomenal success cemented her legendary stature.

She is a caring yet result-orientated business professional with proven abilities in managing and transforming a homegrown consumer-oriented business into a global powerhouse by optimizing productivity, adopting industry best practices, incorporating new technologies and innovative ideas. As the brain and driver behind Phyto Science Sdn Bhd, she provides clear company vision and goals which resulted in a corporate performance surpassing all reasonable expectations.

In 2014, Puan Sri Datin Sri Ela Tan was awarded the ‘Asia Pacific Top Women Entrepreneurs award. In 2015 she was featured on the cover for Global Business Magazine (Tianxia) and in 2016 she made the list of Singapore’s Fast Moving Companies by SME100 with Trendmaker Pte Ltd.

In 2022, Puan Sri Datin Sri Ela Tan was recognized by British Publishing House Ltd as “Successful People in Malaysia” based on outstanding performance. For that, she was listed in the Britishpedia biography in 2022. In 2022, she was also recognized by the Malaysian Chinese Women Entrepreneurs Association and awarded MCWEA Women of Excellence Awards 2022. Pn Sri Datin Sri Ela Tan also received the award for ASEAN Chinese Book of Records and Awards 2022 for ASEAN Chinese Eminent Person Award (Beauty And Wellness) & ASEAN Chinese Enterprise Excellence Award (Beauty And Wellness).

scientists.html:
Meet Our Science Team

At Phyto Science, our Science Team plays a pivotal role in driving the innovation, quality, and trust behind every product we offer. With deep expertise in health and wellness, we are committed to creating science-based formulations that are both effective and safe. Each ingredient is carefully selected and supported by rigorous scientific research, ensuring that our products deliver real, measurable benefits.

Our team stays at the forefront of the latest advancements in health science, continually reviewing new research to improve existing formulations and develop new, cutting-edge solutions. This proactive approach means our customers always receive the most up-to-date and effective products available. Quality and safety are non-negotiable at Phyto Science. From sourcing premium raw materials to performing meticulous testing at every stage of production, our scientists uphold the highest standards to ensure that every product is safe, reliable, and trustworthy.

We also believe that empowering our customers with knowledge is essential. That’s why our Science Team is dedicated to making complex scientific information accessible and easy to understand—helping you make informed choices about your health. Looking ahead, our scientists continue to explore innovative technologies, new ingredients, and emerging methodologies to shape the future of wellness. Their dedication ensures that Phyto Science remains a leader in science-driven health solutions.

At the core of Phyto Science is a promise: every product we create is backed by science, crafted with care, and designed with your well-being in mind. Our Science Team is not just behind the scenes—they are your partners in health.

Dr Gokula Mohan
PhD (Glasgow University, UK)

Specialization: Stem cell biology, epigenetics

Dr. Gokula Mohan holds a PhD in Medical Genetics from the University of Glasgow, where his research focused on human stem cells. He is currently a Senior Lecturer at Universiti Malaya. His research interests span stem cell biology, therapeutics, and cellular epigenetics. Dr. Gokula has led numerous high-impact national and international research projects and serves as an advisor on therapeutic product development, particularly in exosome-based technologies and regenerative medicine.

Dr Taznim Begam Mohd Mohidin
PhD (Universiti Malaya)

Specialization: Immunology and cell biology

Dr. Taznim Begam is a molecular biologist and Senior Lecturer at Universiti Malaya, with academic training in immunology and microbiology. She holds a PhD in Molecular Biology from Universiti Malaya and has contributed to key research in virus-induced oncology, zoonotic disease awareness, and immune regulation. Dr. Taznim is also actively involved in teaching, research, postgraduate supervision, and serves in scientific advisory role for translational microbiome and immunological studies.

Dr Felix See Too Wah Seng
Biotech consultant in Molecular Genomics & Product Innovation

PhD (Universiti Malaya)

Dr. Felix See-Too is a molecular and microbial genomics expert with industry experience in product development, biotechnology innovation, and next-generation sequencing (NGS). He holds a PhD from Universiti Malaya and has served in leadership roles at global biotech MNCs. His research contributions span microbial genomics, protein expression, and bioactive compound discovery. He supports product innovation and translational science strategy across multiple R&D pipelines.

business-collaboration.html:
Business Collaboration

DR. FRED ZULLI

He is the CEO of Mibelle Biochemistry Switzerland which supplies the award winning, clinically researched active ingredient using an exclusive technique – PhytoCellTec™. Mibelle Biochemistry (Switzerland), designs and develops innovative, sustainable and high performing actives based on naturally derived compounds. Mibelle Biochemistry’s “Inspired by nature – Realized by science” motto guides its efforts at combining nature and science through a sustainable plant stem cell cultivation technique – PhytoCellTec™. Since its establishment 23 years ago, Dr. Zulli and his team of scientists have invented a large number of patent protected actives based on different and exclusive technologies.

DR. JONATHAN F. HULL

Received Ph.D in Chemistry from Yale University in 2009 with Professors Robert H. Crabtree and Gary W. Brudvig, completed his postdoctoral studies with Professor Thomas J. Meyer at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, and joined BNL in the fall of 2010 as Goldhaber Distinguished Fellow. Hull designs biologically inspired small molecules for artificial photosynthesis (clean energy storage and catalysis), atom-economic transformations (green chemistry) and the selective functionalization of hydrocarbons (catalysis).

triple-stemcell-h2o.html:
THE ORIGIN OF STEM CELLS

Aqua Water Reservoir Hydration

Water is a potent source of skin food to nourish cells and hydrate skin for a smooth complexion. Our innovative Triple StemCell H2O Moisturizer increases your skin stem cell vitality and regeneration.

This moisturizing gel acts like a water network providing instant freshness while liberating its stem cell ingredients keeping your skin radiant and youthful.

The Largest Stem Cell User In Asia 2013, 2014
The Largest Stem Cell User In The World 2015, 2016, 2017
Know Me

Hydrating Benefits

Stem Cell Extracts

Argan

Stem Cells cultivated from the argan fruit found only in the western part of Morocco. It is known for its regenerative capacity and protection of dermal stem cells. Argan stem cells help to fight ageing symptoms such as wrinkles and promotes the skin’s natural repair process.

Saponaria Pumila (Nunatak)

Stem Cells cultivated from a rare flower that has survived the last Ice Age in the Alps. It is well known for its highly effective repairing mechanism and protective components in the cellular level. Its benefits include maintenance of dermal stem cells, improvement of skin density, elasticity and firmness.

Symphytum

Stem Cell cultivated from a rare flower also known as comfrey. It is well known for its regenerative power of epidermal stem cells and their ability to build new tissues. Its benefits include forming healthy, supple skin with improved barrier against degeneration.

Opuntia Ficus (Aqua Cacteen)

Stem Cell cultivated from the cactus flower from Mexico. It has the ability to block the release of stress markers from sensory nerve cells in the skin enabling a calmed and relaxed skin. This stem cell has outstanding hydrating capabilities due to its high water-binding compounds.

Perfect Benefits

High Level Moisturizer

Triple Stemcell H2O Moisturizer hydrates your skin releasing stem cells into your skin. It soothes, hydrates, restores and nourishes your skin cells so that it remains fresh and supple throughout the day.

Moisturizing your skin all day long!

UV Protection

The sun’s radiation causes our skin to dry. Triple Stemcell H2O Moisturizer naturally protects your skin against UV radiation and works as a defense against dehydration. Protecting your skin against further damages while leaving your skin healthy.

Natural hydration shield!

Anti-free radical & Anti ageing

Free radicals damages your skin and causes ageing. Triple Stemcell H2O Moisturizer releases stem cells into the skin that promotes regeneration and repairs damaged skin. Bringing out your skin’s radiance after each use.

Youthfulness at your fingertips!

crystal-cell.html:
Crystal Cell™ – The Origin of Stem Cells

Unlock Radiant Skin and Lasting Health with Tomato Extracts

Phyto Science proudly presents a new revolutionary product birth from years of research. Tested vigorously for its potency and purity to produce a balanced formula. Phytoene & Phytofluene extracted from tomatoes has the unique ability of blocking harmful free radicals from UV rays. As a result, your skin will be supple and radiant while your body’s health improves continuously.

The Largest Stem Cell User In Asia 2013, 2014
The Largest Stem Cell User In The World 2015, 2016, 2017
Know Me

Nutritional Contents

Unlock Radiant Skin and Lasting Health with Tomato Extracts

Refreshing Ingredients

Stem Cell Extracts

PhytoCellTec™ Malus Domestica (Green Apple)

Stem Cells cultivated from a very rare species of Swiss apples known as “Uttwiler Spätlauber”. It has the ability to protect skin stem cells while delaying the body’s natural ageing process. Benefits of this stem cell are anti-ageing, anti-wrinkle & restoration of new tissues.

PhytoCellTec™ Solar Vitis Grape (Burgundy Grapes)

Stem Cells cultivated specifically from Gamay Teinturier Fréaux Grapes from Burgundy. Rich in polyphenols for UV protection and maintaining vital activities of epidermal stem cells. Benefits include protection of skin stem cells and promotes vitality and healthiness of your body.

Phytonutrients

Tomato (Solanum Lycopersicum)

Tomatoes are rich in colorless carotenoids which are Phytoene and Phytofluene. They are essential to form a natural UV shield on a cellular level. Since human beings cannot produce this, tomatoes are one of the most effective way to naturally protect cells from damaging free radicals.

Acai Berry

Acai berries are rich in antioxidant compounds and Omega 3 Fatty Acids. It is known as a power fruit because of its richness in nutrients such as amino acids, minerals and micronutrients. Its benefits include healthy heart, natural weight loss, boosting immune system, anti-ageing effects.

Blueberry

Blueberries are low in calories but rich in vitamins and antioxidants. It is believed to be the highest antioxidant of all common consumed fruits and vegetables. Its benefits include boosting of immune system, aiding in weight loss, promoting healthy urinary tract and improves heart rate.

Benefits

Proactive UV Protection

Imagine a natural sun block around your skin protecting you all day, free from any drugs or chemicals. Phytoene & Phytofluene are carotenoids with the ability to block the UVA and UVB spectrums.

Leaving your skin radiant and youthful!

Anti-Inflammatory Effect

Live your life to the fullest, don’t let pain consume your life. Pytoene & Phtofluene has unique properties that speed up wound healing and the restoration of acne scars. It also protects DNA strands in skin cells against further damage caused by harmful environmental agents

Living life active and healthy!

Cell Rejuvenation

Finally, damaged cells can be repaired to form new cells. Thanks to the anti-ageing properties of Phytoene & Phytofluene, your skin will be renewed after each use. Leave your friends wondering the secrets to your youth.

Youthfulness at your fingertips!


Crystal Cell is the brainchild of Dr Fred Zulli from Switzerland & Dr Jonathan F. Hull from USA
